fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-07-29, the complainant invested Rs. 75,000 in a scheme promising fixed monthly returns, but payouts stopped after two months. The time of the incident was given as 12:05 on 2025-07-27. The online submission was made by Babu Selvam (9000000442). Rajesh Krishnan (9000000167) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100055. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Sathish Sundaram, using the number 9000000372. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00136, as the mobile number 9000000372 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly persuaded to deposit funds with a promise of high returns.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, suspect, witness, bank reference, mobile number, afternoon, receiving account
